card.name: End of intravenous iron drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of an intravenous iron product name, mainly the 'ose' in ferric carboxymaltose, and also the 'tol' in ferumoxytol. It appears in dosing and warning text for these injections.

modes.label: Ferric carboxymaltose ending
modes.description: The closing 'ose' of ferric carboxymaltose, usually just before the word injection.
modes.example: Only administer ferric carboxymalt<<ose>> injection when personnel and therapies are immediately available

modes.label: Ferumoxytol ending
modes.description: The closing 'tol' of ferumoxytol in an iron product label.
modes.example: Ferumoxy<<tol>> will not interfere with X-ray, computed
